y-m-67-04.topic: Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwahlula: ukwahlula okungathanga ngqo nokwanela kweemeko
y-m-67-04.goal: Funda ukuba kwijiko elinikwe ngokungathanga ngqo, i-x-coordinate enye inokuhambelana namanqaku amaninzi, uze uchaze ngokwahlula amanqaku apho ithambeka lomgca ochukumisayo li-0 namanqaku apho ifomyula yethambeka ingachazwanga.
y-m-67-04.material: Ijiko C: x² + xy + y² = 3 (x no-y ngamanani okwenyani). USoeun wahlula amacala omabini ngokuhlonipha x wafumana dy/dx = −(2x+y)/(x+2y) (apho x+2y≠0). (Funda dy/dx njenge: dy dx.) y-m-67-07.material:
Cinga ngomsebenzi f(x) = xⁿ (n linani lemvelo elingu-3 okanye ngaphezulu). I-derivative yesibini yi-f″(x) = n(n−1)xⁿ⁻² kwaye f″(0) = 0. (Funda f″ njenge: f double prime.) Ichaphaza lotshintsho lichaphaza apho ijika litshintsha phakathi kwe-concave ne-convex, oko kukuthi, ichaphaza apho uphawu lwe-f″ lutshintsha. UDohyun wathi, "Ukuba f″(a) = 0, ngoko (a, f(a)) lichaphaza lotshintsho." Itheyibhile engezantsi ibonisa amaxabiso e-f″(−1), f″(0), f″(1).

y-m-67-09.title: ∫ x ln x dx icombululwe ngeendlela ezimbini
y-m-67-09.topic: Iindlela zokudibanisa: ukuthelekisa iindlela ezimbini zokudibanisa ngamaqhezu
y-m-67-09.goal: Qinisekisa ukuba ubude bokubala bunokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ukhetha njani u-u no-v′ ekudibaniseni ngamaqhezu, nokuba nendlela ebonakala ngathi ayiphumeleli inika isiphumo esifanayo xa yenziwe lula, uze ubhale isizathu sokhetho lwakho.
y-m-67-09.material: Abafundi ababini bazama ukufumana ukudibanisa okungachazwanga ∫ x ln x dx (x>0; kufundwa: ukudibanisa kwe-x amaxesha ilogarithm yendalo ka-x, ngokubhekiselele ku-x) ngokudibanisa ngamaqhezu, ∫u v′ dx = uv − ∫u′ v dx. UJihu uvumela u = ln x no-v′ = x, kwaye uHaeun uvumela u = x no-v′ = ln x. (Cinga ukuba sele uyazi ukuba ukudibanisa okungachazwanga kwe-ln x yi-x ln x − x. Into engatshintshiyo yokudibanisa ibhalwa njenge-C.)

y-m-67-09.s.s1.prompt: Phambi kokuqala ukubala, sesiphi esona siqikelelo sifanelekileyo ngeendlela ezimbini?
y-m-67-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala u-u′ no-v kwindlela nganye kwezimbini uze uthelekise ukuba leliphi elilula.

y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.c: Andikwazi ukugqiba ukuba yeyiphi kwezi ndlela mbini elula phambi kokubala.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.c: Oku kugcina isigwebo phambi kokuzama. Ungasigcina, kodwa ukuze uthelekise kufuneka wenze uqikelelo.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.explain: Ungaqikelela ukuba ukhetho lukaJihu luya kuba lufutshane, kuba ukwahlula u-u kuyenza ilula (1/x) kwaye v′=x inokudityaniswa ngoko nangoko. Kodwa oku akuthethi ukuba ukhetho lukaHaeun alunakwenzeka.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.acc.0: Kunokwenzeka ukugcina isigwebo phambi kokubala, kodwa ukwenza uqikelelo nokuluhlola ngokubala kunceda ukuthelekisa.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.prompt: UHaeun wabala no-u = x kunye no-v = x ln x − x, waza wafumana I = ∫ x ln x dx = x(x ln x − x) − ∫(x ln x − x) dx = x² ln x − x² − I + x²/2. U-I uvela kwakhona kwicala lasekunene. Kwenzeka ntoni kule ndlela?
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukuthatha u-I njengongaziwayo uze ubone ukuba ungalungelelanisa ulingano nge-I macala omabini.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hlula isiphumo osifumeneyo uze uhlole ukuba sibuyela ku-x ln x.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.a: U-I uvela kwakhona, ngoko le ndlela ayinakukucombulula.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.a: Oku kuthathe i-integral efanayo ebonakala kwakhona njengokusilela kwangoko. Hlola ukuba ungalubona lonke ibinzana njengolingano ku-I.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.b: I ivele kwakhona, ngoko yimpazamo yokubala yaye kufuneka ndiqale kwakhona.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.b: Ukuvela kwakhona kwe-I kunye nempazamo yokubala zahlukile. Uqinisekise impazamo ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuba imigca yangaphambili ilunge na.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.c: Ukuba ulungelelanisa kwakhona njengolingano ku-I, ufumana isiphumo esifanayo noJihu.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.c: Ubone ibinzana elinomgca I kumacala omabini njengolingano olunye.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.explain: Ukumisela x² ln x − x²/2 − I ilingane no-I kunika 2I = x² ln x − x²/2, ngoko I = (x²/2) ln x − x²/4 + C. Isiphumo sikaJihu sifanayo. Ukwahlula ibinzana olifumeneyo kunika x ln x.

y-m-67-10.topic: Iindlela ze-integration: ixabiso le-definite integral nomgama ohanjiweyo

y-m-67-10.material: Vumela v(t) m/s libe lijubane kwixesha t (iisekhondi) lerobhothi ehamba ngomgca othe ngqo. Thatha icala lasekunene njenge-+, uze uvumele v(t) iqhubeke. (Ukufuduka kutshintsho lwendawo ukusuka kwindawo yokuqala ukuya kwindawo yamva, yaye umgama ohanjiweyo sisixa sobude bonke obubaleke ngaphandle kokujonga icala.) Apha ngezantsi kukuzama ukufumana "umgama wonke ohanjiweyo" xa v(t) = t − 2, 0 ≤ t ≤ 4.
